sources.label: Synthetic
sources.description: A fully simulated universe of 1,200 hospital-employed cardiologists with a hidden outcome simulated from the model's own hypotheses -- it tests the pipeline, not the hypotheses.

sources.label: Real identities
sources.description: Real cardiologists from the public NIH/NLM NPI registry. Identity, location and subspecialty are real; employer, every behavioral signal, and the outcome are simulated and are NOT facts about these physicians.

sources.label: Real data
sources.description: Real cardiologists from public CMS Medicare records, hospital-based by billing setting (inferred). Same ten signals as Synthetic, but none has a real source connected, so all are empty and nothing is scored.
